world_news_real.title: 'Unprecedented' rain in Japan kills eight people
world_news_real.description: The storm cut power to more than 20,000 households and left 7,000 people stranded at Tokyo's Narita airport.

world_news_real.title: US says dozens of countries helped China dodge Trump's tariffs
world_news_real.description: A new US report said China had moved goods through nations with lower tariffs to dodge higher levies.

world_news_real.title: Engine parts smashed Ryanair window that man's head was sucked out of, report says
world_news_real.description: A preliminary report by US investigators says an engine fan blade broke on last month's flight from Greece to Germany.

world_news_real.title: Conditions on US aircraft carrier at sea for more than 250 days raise alarms
world_news_real.description: Thousands of sailors on the USS Abraham Lincoln have reportedly faced food shortages and broken plumbing, with some considering jumping overboard.

world_news_real.title: Stolen Matisse artworks recovered by police in Brazil
world_news_real.description: A man is arrested after eight works by the French artist are found at a home in greater São Paulo.

world_news_real.title: Presidential vote counting halted in Zambia over alleged attacks on polling staff
world_news_real.description: The electoral commission said violence had "resulted in the theft of marked ballot papers".

world_news_real.title: US missionary released following kidnap in Niger, Christian group says
world_news_real.description: Kevin Rideout, who was kidnapped outside his home in the capital last October, is now with US officials.

world_news_real.title: Palestinians told to leave homes in village where Israeli settlers besieged houses
world_news_real.description: The mayor of Qusra says Israeli troops have been telling families to leave their houses, using some as barracks.

world_news_real.title: Person fined after using foghorn to wake sleeping polar bear
world_news_real.description: Under local regulations in the region, "it is forbidden to needlessly disturb, attract or pursue a polar bear".

world_news_real.title: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level
world_news_real.description: The Cernavodă plant, which produces 20% of Romania's electricity, is not expected to be restarted within the next 10 days.
